claim: The decomposer had no verb for a QUESTION, so count-shape was refused before the page was read. Adding COUNT fixes it completely: 0/5 -> 5/5.

measurement.instrument: full 130 tasks x 5 reps, page identity per rep, exclusive CDP browser

regression_check.method: the five largest DOWN moves re-measured at 10 reps
regression_check.verdict: NO regression from this round's code. Every rerun lands at or above the r178 reading, and the email family (built in r174) reads 0.80/0.90 -- it is intact. The whole-suite swing is the known instability of ~20 tasks, not a defect.

mechanisms: COUNT must run FIRST in VERB_PATTERNS: a counting question often also contains an action word.
The page's description grammar is exactly SIZE + COLOUR + TEXT (common/shapes.js generalDesc).
THE GRID DRAWS THREE KINDS OF NODE -- rect, circle, <text> -- so counting only <text> made every 'shapes' and 'digits' question wrong.
A NAMED GEOMETRY IS A TAG FILTER: 'how many rectangles' counts <rect>.
KEEP THE CASE OF THE NOUN: 'How many Is' names the glyph I, not the English word 'is'.
The noun is only ever the LAST word before 'are/is' -- two competing rules for this broke the function once.
honest_reading: This round is a net-negative reading with a genuine positive inside it. The repaired task is real (0 -> 5/5 at 5 reps, 10/12 at 12 reps). The suite total moved -1.69 pp, which is inside one SE. The lesson is not about the code: at 650 trials a single-task repair is worth +0.77 pp and the noise band is +-2.7 pp, so THIS INSTRUMENT CANNOT SHOW ONE TASK AT A TIME. Repairs must now be batched by the dozen before measuring.
